audio.text: I'm thinking of dropping my evening class.

options: I dropped my phone on the way to class this morning.
Evening classes usually start at six.
I think the class has about forty students.
Talk to your advisor before you make up your mind.

why.en: Statement → advice (idiom: "make up your mind" = decide). A repeats "drop" in its literal sense; C echoes "think" and "class" without responding.
why.tr: Bildirim → tavsiye (deyim: "make up your mind" = karar vermek). A "drop" kelimesini gerçek anlamıyla tekrar ediyor; C "think" ve "class" kelimelerini yankılıyor ama cevap vermiyor.
why.es: Comentario → un consejo (expresión: "make up your mind" = decidirse). A repite "drop" en sentido literal; C repite "think" y "class" sin responder.
